question: Can independent readers apply the refusal-narrowing codebook reliably, and does the resulting report-only measure show enough treatment/reference spread to justify a fresh confirmatory registration?

source.eligibleRows: rows whose archived launcher status is exactly complete; retained substantive failures are excluded because no complete outcome-horizon public packet exists
source.sealedInputRule: every selected report.json and transcript.json must be byte-identical to the named private archive commit

sample.selection: within each version-by-arm stratum, select one complete row per world by SHA-256 rank; select a second world_005 row in the four eligible strata with the lowest seeded extra-world rank and a second world_030 row in the other four strata
sample.blindCaseIds: assign nrw_001 through nrw_024 by an independent seeded SHA-256 rank after selection

instrument.learnerStates: trigger and every post_N through the registered final outcome horizon
instrument.combinedDirection: narrower only when at least one final mark improves from trigger and none worsens; wider is the mirror case; mixed means improvement and worsening coexist; unchanged means no mark changes

readers.visibility: reader sees only a blinded case id, the rule-only reader instrument, and the public dialogue from trigger through final post; no arm, version, source job id, prior ladder vote, hidden learner state, or worked example
readers.invalidOutput: retain as an ineligible seat result; never re-ask, replace, or select by content
readers.transportFailure: seal the failure and halt before the next call

fields: open-demand count on jointly scored states
bound-tightness score on jointly scored states
conceded-subclaim count on jointly scored states
agreementGates.evidenceRule: an eligible result exact-matches every cited span to the named learner source and never cites a future state

spreadGate.decision: open a fresh-study design only if every agreement gate passes and every spread floor passes; otherwise close this card with the observed no-agreement or no-spread result

attemptCeiling.calculation: 24 sampled rows x 3 independent reader seats x 1 attempt
attemptCeiling.role: fail-before-call hard ceiling, not a target

claimBoundary: This calibration may establish only whether the narrowing instrument is readable and shows exploratory arm spread on superseded archived simulations. It cannot establish a treatment effect, learning, pedagogical quality, or any confirmatory result, and its rows can never be pooled into a fresh study.

launch.requirements: merged design, clean detached launch commit containing it, and one signed GO note naming that commit, this design path, and the 72-attempt cap
launch.destination: create-once path under the private archive artifacts/tutor-stub-live directory
launch.archive: all plan, per-seat, ledger, failure, and report artifacts stay in the private archive repository
